does: Reads the loading-screen hints file through the visitor ls::FileFormatIO::LoadFile gives it: region Hints, root attribute HintDuration (5.0 when absent, at +0x58) and one 0x38-byte ecl::Hint per Hint node; the array (+0x8, count +0x14) is emptied and resized to the file's count first, so a second call replaces the list and resets HintDuration.

evidence.says: macOS bg3_macos_x64+0x359B420 reads strHints, strHintDuration, strController, strDescription, strHintKey, strInternal, strKeyboard, strWikiPage; count reset before the fill
live dx11 copy attacks: HintManager count 49 = the 49 Hint nodes of Public/Game/Hints/Hints.lsx, HintDuration 5.0, first entry Controller 0 / Keyboard 1 as HINT_CAM_HOME
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; a stored pair of the two builds joins that function to this one (a seed)
EoCClient.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by pseudo-code

dx11 array visitor bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x17F1360 sets the count to 0, reallocates to the visitor's count with a 0x38-byte element destructor, then fills each element; HintManager's vtable bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x55F40D0 slot 0 is this function, the slot ls::FileFormatIO::LoadFile calls
